subject: general
question:
In the following questions, some part of the sentence is underlined, which of the options given below the sentence should replace the part underlined to make the sentence grammatically correct. If the sentence is correct as it is given then choose the option ‘No Correction required’ as the answer.

They __**were congratulated him for**__ his anniversary.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Congratulated him on'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence, *"They were congratulated him for his anniversary**,"* contains an error in the usage of the verb &a
